verdict.rationale: PayPal ships an official Agent Toolkit library in TypeScript and Python on its own GitHub org, with adapters for OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, CrewAI, Bedrock and MCP. It also publishes official OpenAPI specs with documented codegen (e.g., codegen-java) and an npm-distributed @paypal/mcp package. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of general-purpose official server SDKs for the core payments APIs across major languages (codegen is self-generated, not a maintained SDK), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
